expected.title: Global meromorphic continuation of Lie-derivative resolvents for smooth Axiom A flows with strong transversality on closed manifolds
expected.author: Antoine Meddane
expected.difficulty_reason: The cited anisotropic spectral theorem does not provide a global escape function for a non-Anosov Axiom A flow with several basic sets and heteroclinic connections. The author constructs new compatible filtrations and cotangent-cone controls, then proves compactness of the global conormal distributions by following an increasing chain of basic sets. These results supply the complete global energy and escape construction needed to apply the precise published vector-bundle resolvent theorem on arbitrarily large half-planes.
